registration.title: Who can sign in
registration.open: Open: anyone signing in with a new email gets an account of their own, with the User role.
registration.inviteOnly: Invite only: only people an administrator added can sign in. Nobody else gets a code.

confirm.openDescription: From the moment you confirm, anyone with a valid email will be able to create an account and sign in without you adding them. You can switch back whenever you want.
confirm.inviteOnlyDescription: From the moment you confirm, only people you add can sign in. Everyone who already has an account keeps signing in: to lock someone out, deactivate their account.

feedback.uncertain: We could not confirm the save. Check the current values before saving again.
feedback.conflict: Another administrator changed the settings. Check the current values.
feedback.failed: We could not save the settings changes.
feedback.reviewFailed: We could not check the current settings.
feedback.lateUncertain: We could not confirm the settings save. Check the current values.
feedback.lateFailed: We could not save the settings changes.

hints.regional: Initial values for new accounts and public pages. Each person keeps their preferences.
hints.idioma: Initial language for new accounts and public screens. Each person keeps their preference.
hints.zona-horaria: Initial time zone for new accounts. Each person keeps their profile preference; dates are stored in UTC.
hints.listados: Initial number of rows. Each list can use a different size.
hints.registro: Choose who can create an account in the system.

leave.title: Discard changes?
leave.description: These changes have not been saved yet.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: These colors apply to everyone and to sign-in screens. The preview shows your draft; the system changes when you save.
appearance.contrast: Text and focus adjust to remain readable. Error, warning and success colors retain their meaning.
appearance.name: Name
